title: C++ and Beyond 2012: Herb Sutter - atomic Weapons 2 of 2
summary: Part two of Herb Sutter's C++ and Beyond 2012 session on atomic weapons, a deep dive into the C++ memory model, atomics, memory ordering, and hardware behavior. It ends with the modern meaning of volatile.
why: HN recommends it as an in-depth, practical introduction to atomics and weak versus strong memory ordering, relevant to ARM and Rust as well as C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
